title: Single-phase: 50 m, 4 mm2 out-and-back to a 2 kW load at 230 V
source: Hand calculation, independent of the engine code (python, standard library only): Closed form: V = (V0 + sqrt(V0^2 - 4 P R)) / 2 with R = 2 r L at 70 degrees C (reactance does not matter at unity power factor with this model only approximately; tolerance 0.05 percent).
